name: 柯明村
objective:
本課程將介紹化學儲能裝置和儲冷系統之基礎與實務。課程內容包括：(一) 儲能裝置理論與技術：電池儲能系統與模組、轉換器等。(二) 儲冷系統理論與技術：儲冰水式系統，各式儲冰系統如全凍結式、冰盤管式、冰泥式、動態製冰式、優態鹽及冰球式等。
This course including two parts:electrochemical energy storage/conversion theory and technology, and thermal storage 
system fundamental and technology: (1) Electric cell engergy conversion system and module, transformerell and proton-exchanging, (2) chilled water system and ice storage systems such as total freeze-up, ice-on-coil,
ice slurry, dynamic ice builder, eutectic salt and ice ball systechnology will also be covered.  The advanced PCM for thermal storage will be investigated as a hint to the students.
schedule:
A. Recent Technology in Energy Storage and Application
    1. Introduction to Energy storage
    2. Advanced Energy Storage Technology

B. Thermal Energy Storage
    1. Introduction to Cool Thermal Storage
    2. Fundamental Design Concepts
    3. Comparison of Thermal Storage Technologies
	    Comparison of Overall systems
	    Chilled water storage
	    Ice Harvesting systems
	    External melt ice-on-coil storage systems
	    Internal melt ice-on-coil storage systems
	    Encapsulated ice
	    Eutectic salt phase-change materials
    4. Design Procedures

C. Net-Zero Emissions and Carbon Management
    1. Trends in Net-Zero Emissions
    2. Quantification and reporting of greenhouse gas (GHG)
    3. Greenhouse Gas Inventory Management
    4. Carbon Footprint Verification (CFV) and Carbon Rights

D. Presentations and Discussions on Special Topics
